summary: account estimate now reads the live creditCount balance field (like account budget), errors on an unreadable balance instead of reporting a spurious over-budget exit 7, and its Example plans a run that fits a healthy account balance.
reason: The live /v1/account/credit-balance envelope carries creditCount; estimate parsed only balance/credits, so every live run resolved the balance to 0 and exited 7 ('over budget') regardless of the real balance. Found by the publish live gate: the fresh full dogfood failed the estimate probes while the account really held ~13.9k credits. Durable rule: a zero parsed balance is indistinguishable from an unrecognized envelope shape and must be an explicit error, never a budget verdict; and command Examples double as live dogfood probes, so they must plan runs that pass on a healthy account.
validated_outcome: Live: 'account estimate --posts 950 --with-replies flat' now reports balance 13906 and a legitimate over-budget exit 7 (14250 > 13906); '--posts 40' and '--posts 10' exit 0. Full unit suite green.
